comparison.objective: Sweep test rods through two light-curtain fields, observe which curtain fails, and tag out that machine; the candidate mechanically adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2070 tests controlled rod sweeping across complete sensing fields, maintaining orientation and speed, perceiving lamp state, and inserting a tag. The candidate tests precision driver and wrench use, countertorque, regrasping, and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2070 requires all 45 cells of both fields covered, correct post-test tagging, rods withdrawn, release, stillness, and no dropped rod or tag. The candidate requires retained angular accuracy over three cycles with nuts retained and tools clear. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Safety-field coverage and fault-dependent tagging exercise inspection and decision-guided placement, not coupled screw adjustment, jam-nut locking, or retention of a mechanical calibration.
